commit.message:
Add PriorityClasses to Astarte CRD and reconciliation loop

PriorityClasses allow to introduce priorities in the scheduling of pods.
When the feature is enabled in the Astarte CR, heavier pods will be scheduled
before lighter ones, allowing them to secure resources first.
Three default priority classes are introduced and the user is allowed to
customize the priority value (otherwise, sane defaults are included).

Signed-off-by: Arnaldo Cesco <arnaldo.cesco@secomind.com>

commit.message:
Support horizontal autoscaling

Extend the Astarte CR to support the k8s HPA using the `autoscaling` feature gate.
The `autoscaler.horizontal` field in an Astarte component's spec allows to
reference an `HorizontalPodAutoscaler` object.
Since queue distribution does not allow for underscaling, RabbitMQ is not autoscalable.
Since DataUpdaterPlant is deployed as a group of independent Deployments, it is not autoscalable.
For persistency reasons, neither the in-cluster Cassandra deployment is autoscalable.

Signed-off-by: Arnaldo Cesco <arnaldo.cesco@secomind.com>
